title: Diagnostic of Iron Deficiency by Means of Non Invasive Measurement of Zink Protoporphyrin IX
brief_summary: ZnPP is being build in the case of a functional iron deficiency. Zinc instead of iron is implemented into protoporphyrin IX. This ZincProtoporphyrin (ZnPP) can be detected non invasively. Non invasive and invasive optical measurement of ZnPP will be compared. Additionally ZnPP measurements will be compared to other iron deficiency parameters for validation by the investigators.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients seen preoperatively in the Anesthestic clinic
* Patients \> 18 years of age
* Understood and signed patient consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* transfusion of blood products 8 weeks prior to screening
* Pregnancy
* Porphyria
study_population: Patients prior to a surgery, seen in the Anesthetic clinic for evaluation
